error.all_printers_configured: All discovered Zebra printers are already configured in Home Assistant.
error.already_configured: This printer is already configured in Home Assistant.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read Zebra settings from this printer
error.discovery_network_error: Home Assistant could not read its network adapters. Check the Network settings, retry discovery, or enter the printer address manually.
error.discovery_no_interfaces: Home Assistant has no enabled IPv4 broadcast interface for discovery. Enable an IPv4 network or enter the printer address manually.
error.discovery_transport_error: Home Assistant could not bind or send discovery probes on the network. Check network permissions and UDP broadcast access, or enter the printer address manually.
error.identity_conflict: Home Assistant could not safely migrate this printer's device identity. The connection was not changed.
error.identity_mismatch: The selected printer has a different stable identity. The connection was not changed.
error.identity_unavailable: This entry uses a stable printer identity, but the selected printer did not report one. The connection was not changed.
error.no_compatible_printers_found: Devices replied to discovery, but none could be verified as compatible Zebra printers. Enter a printer address manually.
error.no_printers_found: No Zebra printers replied to discovery. Enter the printer address manually or check local UDP broadcast access.

discovered.description: Choose a printer to add, or choose manual setup.
discovered.title: Zebra printers found

reconfigure.description: Enter the printer's current host and raw TCP port. The integration verifies its Zebra settings before saving.
reconfigure.title: Update printer connection

data_description.rescan: Use this after checking local UDP broadcast access if the printer did not appear.

user.description: Choose a discovered printer, or enter its address and raw printing port manually. Discovery requires local UDP broadcast traffic.
user.title: Connect to a Zebra printer

counter_reset_failed.message: Could not reset the label counter. Check the printer connection and SGD write access.

media_calibration_failed.message: Could not calibrate media. Check the printer connection and whether the media can be calibrated.

print_configuration_change_failed.message: Could not update the print configuration. Check the printer connection and setting support.

pause_control_failed.message: Could not send the pause or resume command. Check the printer connection.

print_method_change_failed.message: Could not change the print method. Check the printer connection and SGD write access.

ribbon_cartridge_not_present.message: Ribbon cartridge support is unavailable on this printer.

ribbon_required.message: Load a ribbon cartridge before selecting Thermal Transfer.

ribbon_warning_change_failed.message: Could not change the low-ribbon warning. Check the printer connection and its ribbon-cartridge support.

test_print_failed.message: Could not send the test label. The job may have reached the printer; check before retrying.

unsupported_media_type.message: The selected media type is not supported.

unsupported_print_configuration_value.message: The value is outside the supported range for this printer.

unsupported_print_method.message: The selected print method is not supported.

unsupported_ribbon_warning.message: The selected low-ribbon threshold is not supported.

error.alerts_cannot_connect: Cannot read alert capabilities from this printer. Check its connection and try again.
error.alerts_invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP base URL that the printer can reach. The resulting webhook URL must be no longer than 255 characters.
error.alerts_select_condition: Select at least one printer condition.
error.alerts_unsupported: This printer does not report support for HTTP-POST alerts and every selected condition.
error.media_roll_counter_unavailable: Cannot read the printer's lifetime media counter. The estimate was not changed.
error.media_roll_length_invalid: Enter a finite roll length greater than zero.
error.media_roll_printer_not_ready: The printer is not ready. Check its connection and try again.
error.media_roll_remaining_exceeds_roll: Remaining media length cannot exceed the full roll length.
error.media_roll_remaining_invalid: Enter a finite remaining length of zero or more.

alerts.description: Enable or disable printer event alerts. Enabling opens the destination and condition settings.
alerts.title: Printer event alerts

data.alerts_base_url: Home Assistant base URL reachable by the printer

data_description.alerts_base_url: For example, http://192.168.1.10:8123. The integration adds the webhook path. Do not include credentials, a query, or a fragment.
data_description.alerts_conditions: Only conditions reported by this printer and its HTTP-POST destination are accepted. Both set and clear alerts are sent.

alerts_config.description: Send selected printer alerts to Home Assistant. Enter an HTTP base URL the printer can reach on your local network. Home Assistant registers a local-only webhook; its secret ID is generated and kept private.
alerts_config.title: Configure printer event alerts

data_description.media_roll_length_inches: Enter the nominal length of a new full roll.
data_description.media_roll_remaining_inches: Leave blank for a new full roll. Enter the estimated remaining length for a partly used roll.

media_roll.description: Use this after loading a roll. The printer's current lifetime media counter is saved as the estimate baseline.
media_roll.title: Set media roll estimate

print.description: Send raw ZPL to one configured Zebra printer. The action refuses to send while PDF Direct is active. A successful call means the data was handed to the TCP connection; the printer does not confirm that a label was physically printed.

zpl.description: Raw ZPL text sent as supplied. Add ^CI28 to the ZPL when the printer should interpret UTF-8 text.
zpl.name: ZPL

print.name: Print label

print_pdf.description: Send an uploaded PDF unchanged to one configured Zebra printer. PDF Direct requires Link-OS 6.3 or newer and must already be active. This action does not change the printer's virtual device setting. Match the PDF page size to the loaded label. The printer does not confirm that a label was physically printed.

pdf_file.description: Upload a PDF label from this device. The file is sent unchanged, then the temporary upload is removed; upload it again for another print.
pdf_file.name: PDF label

print_pdf.name: Print PDF label

send_firmware_file.description: WARNING: Firmware updates can brick the printer. Use only a Zebra firmware file for the exact printer model. This action sends the uploaded file but cannot verify or recover the firmware. A successful call means Home Assistant handed the file to the TCP connection; the printer does not confirm that it accepted or installed it. After the printer reconnects, compare its Firmware sensor with the intended version.

firmware_file.description: Upload a Zebra firmware file from this device. The temporary upload is removed when the action reads it; upload it again for another attempt.
firmware_file.name: Firmware file

send_firmware_file.name: Send firmware file

set_media_roll.description: Set the installed roll length and establish a fresh estimate baseline. Omit the remaining length for a new full roll.

remaining_length_inches.description: Optional current remaining length for a partly used roll or when resetting after the printer counter changes.
remaining_length_inches.name: Media remaining now (inches)

roll_length_inches.description: Nominal length of a new full roll, in inches.
roll_length_inches.name: Full roll length (inches)

set_media_roll.name: Set media roll baseline
